tagging_basis: OCR H432 numbered specification sections (lettered learning outcomes as evidence)

units.label: 1(a)(i)
units.summary: Explain what is meant by ionic bonding.

units.label: 1(a)(ii)
units.summary: Draw a dot-and-cross diagram for potassium sulfide showing outer electrons.

units.label: 1(b)
units.summary: Draw a dot-and-cross diagram for sulfur difluoride including lone pairs.
units.difficulty_basis: Covalent diagram with lone pairs on unfamiliar molecule

units.label: 1(c)
units.summary: Explain why K2S is a solid but SF2 is a gas using structure and bonding.
units.difficulty_basis: Compare giant ionic with simple molecular

units.label: 1(d)(i)
units.summary: State the shape and bond angle of an SF6 molecule.

units.label: 1(d)(ii)
units.summary: Suggest why SF6 is unreactive.
units.difficulty_basis: Needs bond polarity and symmetry reasoning in unfamiliar context

units.label: 2(a)
units.summary: State what is meant by a radical.

units.label: 2(b)
units.summary: Name the type of bond breaking in radical substitution.

units.label: 2(c)
units.summary: Show two monosubstituted bromoalkane products from alkane A reacting with bromine.

units.label: 2(d)
units.summary: Write an equation using structures for alkane A with excess bromine forming a dibromo compound.

units.label: 3(a)
units.summary: State the colour change at the end point with phenolphthalein.

units.label: 3(b)(i)
units.summary: Complete a table of titres from burette readings.

units.label: 3(b)(ii)
units.summary: Explain why a trial titration is carried out.

units.label: 3(b)(iii)
units.summary: Calculate the mean titre from concordant results.
units.difficulty_basis: Simple averaging after choosing concordant values

units.label: 3(b)(iv)
units.summary: Calculate the percentage uncertainty in a titre from burette reading uncertainty.

units.label: 3(c)
units.summary: Calculate the value of n in a dicarboxylic acid from titration and mass data.
units.difficulty_basis: Long multi-step titration with molar mass deduction

units.label: 3(d)
units.summary: State and explain the effect on the titre of rinsing a pipette with water.
units.difficulty_basis: Reasoning about dilution of the analyte

units.label: 4(a)
units.summary: Calculate the enthalpy change of decomposition of magnesium carbonate from calorimetry data and a cycle.
units.difficulty_basis: Extended multi-step calorimetry plus Hess cycle

units.label: 5(a)
units.summary: Write the Kc expression for methanol formation.

units.label: 5(b)(i)
units.summary: Calculate the equilibrium concentration of methanol from Kc and concentrations.
units.difficulty_basis: Rearranged Kc with a squared term

units.label: 5(b)(ii)
units.summary: State what the numerical value of Kc shows about position of equilibrium.

units.label: 5(c)
units.summary: Suggest two environmental benefits of a lower operating temperature.
units.difficulty_basis: Link catalysis to energy and CO2 savings

units.label: 5(d)(i)
units.summary: State which block of the periodic table nickel is in.

units.label: 5(d)(ii)
units.summary: Complete the electron configuration of gallium.

units.label: 5(e)
units.summary: Identify a Period 3 element from its first six ionisation energies and explain.

units.label: 6(a)
units.summary: Draw a best fit curve and find the rate at 50 s from a tangent gradient.

units.label: 6(b)
units.summary: Suggest an advantage and a disadvantage of measuring rate by mass loss rather than gas volume.
units.difficulty_basis: Evaluation of method with small mass of hydrogen

units.label: 6(c)(i)
units.summary: Calculate the mass of barium containing the same moles as the strontium sample.

units.label: 6(c)(ii)
units.summary: Sketch the volume against time graph for the faster barium reaction.
units.difficulty_basis: Predict graph shape with same final volume

units.label: 6(c)(iii)
units.summary: Describe and explain the difference in reactivity of barium and strontium with water.
units.difficulty_basis: Group 2 trend argument over four points

units.label: 7(a)
units.summary: Write a balanced equation using skeletal formulae for a tertiary alcohol reacting with HCl.

units.label: 7(b)
units.summary: Explain purification of a liquid haloalkane and calculate the expected mass from percentage yield.
units.difficulty_basis: Extended answer combining practical and yield calculation

units.label: 7(c)(i)
units.summary: Name a secondary alcohol isomer of 2-methylpropan-2-ol.

units.label: 7(c)(ii)
units.summary: Write the equation for oxidation of a branched primary alcohol under reflux with dichromate.
units.difficulty_basis: Needs correct product with excess oxidant
